vault.banner.copied: An item you restored had been removed from the server for good, so it was saved again as a new copy.
vault.banner.sign_in_again: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again to keep your changes in sync.
vault.dialog.missing_body: The server no longer shows this item, so it cannot be kept in sync. The copy on this device is removed for good, and nothing is uploaded again. If you only want to wait, cancel and leave it as it is.
vault.edit.generated: A new password was filled in and is shown. Use the eye button to hide it.
vault.edit.generated_prefill: The password from the generator is filled in. Use the eye button to see it.
vault.edit.heading: Edit item
vault.edit.name: Name
vault.edit.not_editable: This item cannot be changed right now. Open it to see why.
vault.edit.notes_help: The notes stay hidden until you ask for them.
vault.edit.password_history: A new password moves the old one to Previous passwords on the item page.
vault.edit.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
vault.edit.title: Edit item
vault.edit.totp_help: Paste the otpauth:// address, or type the secret key (Base32) that the website shows. Leave empty for none.
vault.edit.totp_help_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored one-time password. Paste a new address or secret key to replace it.
vault.edit.totp_own_host: This looks like the one-time password for this Ferret server. If you keep it here and then lose access to your vault, you cannot sign in to recover it. Keep it somewhere else.
vault.edit.totp_remove_body: The one-time password is taken out of this item when you save it. Make sure you can still sign in to the website another way.
vault.edit.totp_removed: The one-time password will be removed when you save.
vault.error.clipboard: The clipboard could not be used. Show the value and copy it by hand.
vault.error.item_changed: This item was changed, probably on another device, while you were editing it. Your edits were not saved. Go back to the item, look at it again and then edit it.
vault.error.malformed_otpauth: This is not a time-based one-time password. Use an otpauth://totp address or a Base32 secret key. Counter-based (HOTP) and Steam codes are not supported.
vault.error.name_required: Enter a name for the item.
vault.error.read_only_schema: This item was saved by a newer version of the vault. It can be read here but not changed.
vault.error.reveal_failed: The value could not be shown.
vault.error.sync_unavailable: The vault is open, but syncing could not start. Lock the vault and open it again.
vault.error.worker_failed: The part of the page that holds your keys stopped. Reload the page and try again.
vault.item.copied_secret: {label} copied. Ferret clears it in 30 seconds if this tab is open.
vault.item.title: Item
vault.list.empty: There are no items yet. Make the first one.
vault.list.search_placeholder: Search by name, address or user name
vault.list.title: Items
vault.nav.label: Vault
vault.new.title: New item
vault.notice.damaged: The newest version of this item from the server cannot be opened. The last good version is shown. The item cannot be changed or deleted until that is sorted out.
vault.notice.missing: The server's list does not show this item. It is kept on this device and is being uploaded again. You cannot change it meanwhile.
vault.notice.quarantined: The server says this item is deleted, but the deletion could not be checked. The copy on this device is kept, and the item cannot be changed or deleted.
vault.notice.read_only: This item was saved by a newer version of the vault. You can read it here, but it cannot be changed or deleted.
vault.unlock.busy: Opening the vault. This takes a few seconds.
vault.unlock.ended: Your session has ended. Enter your master password to open the vault again.
vault.unlock.heading: Unlock your vault
vault.unlock.passkey.help: Your browser asks you to prove that it is you, with a fingerprint, a face or a PIN. The master password and your recovery key still work.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.method_change: This passkey was changed on another device. Use the master password, then look at Account › Unlock methods.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.method_remove: That passkey is no longer an unlock method of this account. Use the master password.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.passkey_bad_a: The answer of the browser was not what this page asked for. The vault was not opened.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.passkey_block: The browser refused at once, before it asked you anything. The vault was not opened. Check the following, or use the master password.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.passkey_cance: The passkey prompt was closed or ran out of time. The vault was not opened. You can try again.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.passkey_faile: The passkey did not work. The vault was not opened. Use the master password.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.passkey_not_v: The passkey did not check who is using it (a PIN, a fingerprint or a face). A passkey without that check cannot open the vault.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.passkey_other: The browser used another passkey than the ones that open this vault. The vault was not opened.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.passkey_secur: The browser refused to use a passkey for this web address. The vault has to be opened over https with its host name, not with an IP address.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.passkey_unloc: The passkey did not open the vault. Try again, or use the master password.
vault.unlock.passkey_error.passkey_unsup: This browser or system cannot use a passkey for this. Use the master password.
vault.unlock.secret_key_help: This device does not remember the secret key. It is on your emergency sheet.
vault.unlock.title: Unlock
